verdict.rationale: Appwrite exposes basic delete APIs for files, database rows, and users (appwrite-docs-10, appwrite-docs-12) and self-hosting gives 'full control over data location' (appwrite-docs-24), which together let a user delete or relocate data. However there is no documented retention-policy feature (TTL, scheduled purges, GDPR-style bulk erasure workflows) beyond ad-hoc API/CLI deletes. Missing for 10: explicit data-retention policy controls, automated expiry/purge scheduling, and dedicated compliance-deletion tooling beyond basic CRUD delete calls.
